content.value_statement: AI-generated HTML often misses required structure and breaks downstream publishing. This skill checks HTML5 structure and records clear validation results.
actual_capabilities: Checks required HTML5 elements, including doctype, html, head, body, title, stylesheet, and main container.
Validates tag closure, nesting, headings, lists, image tags, links, and tables.
Separates blocking structural errors from non-blocking warnings.
Produces a validation report with status, counts, check results, errors, warnings, and summary metrics.
Stops the pipeline on structural failures through exit codes and hook workflow guidance.
Supports strict mode where warnings can fail validation.
limitations: It depends on an existing validate_html.py tool that is not included in this skill.
It focuses on structure, not visual rendering, accessibility, or semantic correctness.
It uses project-specific page paths and CSS container conventions from the Calypso pipeline.
It does not verify that external links or image files are reachable.

use_cases.title: Validate generated web pages
use_cases.description: Check AI-generated HTML pages before they move into consolidation, review, or publishing steps.

use_cases.title: Enforce publishing quality gates
use_cases.description: Stop a chapter or page pipeline when required HTML structure is missing or malformed.

use_cases.title: Create repeatable QA reports
use_cases.description: Record pass, fail, warning, and summary details for each generated page under review.

prompt_templates.title: Validate One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of one generated HTML file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate the generated HTML file at [path]. Check structure, required tags, and tag closure. Summarize errors and warnings clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Review Failed Structure Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate troubleshooting after a validation failure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the structure validation result for [page]. Explain each blocking error, likely cause, and the smallest safe HTML fix.

prompt_templates.title: Run Strict Quality Gate
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate validation where warnings should fail the gate.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run structure validation for [chapter] in strict mode. Treat warnings as failures and prepare a concise gate decision.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Validation Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a structure validation step for the generated HTML pipeline. Include inputs, report location, failure behavior, and retry guidance.

output_examples.input: A generated page is missing a closing body tag.
output_examples.output: The result fails. The report identifies the missing closing tag, marks the structure gate as blocked, and recommends repairing the page.

output_examples.input: A generated page has valid structure but starts with a second-level heading.
output_examples.output: The result passes with a warning. The report notes the heading hierarchy issue and allows the pipeline to continue unless strict mode is active.

output_examples.input: A chapter pipeline needs validation before pages are merged.
output_examples.output: The workflow validates each page, saves a report beside the page artifacts, and stops processing when structural errors appear.

best_practices: Run this validation immediately after HTML generation and before semantic review.
Keep the validator script versioned with the project that uses this skill.
Treat errors as blockers and review warnings before final publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat successful browser rendering as proof of valid structure.
Do not suppress failed validation without saving a report and reviewing the root cause.
Do not reuse project-specific class checks in unrelated templates without updating the rules.

faq.question: What does this skill validate?
faq.answer: It validates required HTML5 structure, tag closure, metadata, content containers, headings, lists, links, images, and tables.

faq.question: Does it check visual design?
faq.answer: No. It checks structural correctness. It does not verify layout, styling quality, or browser rendering.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that operate on generated HTML files.

faq.question: Does the skill include the Python validator?
faq.answer: No. It expects an existing validate_html.py tool in the project where the validation workflow runs.

faq.question: What happens when validation fails?
faq.answer: The described workflow stops the pipeline, saves a validation report, and asks the user to fix or regenerate the HTML.

faq.question: Are warnings blocking?
faq.answer: Warnings are not blocking by default. Strict mode can treat warnings as failures when a stronger quality gate is needed.
